paragraphs.text: Mobile and small-screen fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web shell, as a toggleable plugin.
# dsh-agentbox
Mobile and small-screen fixes for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web shell, packaged as a **plugin** rat
her than a patch — so it survives DSH updates.
Born from running DSH as an always-on agent box driven mostly from a phone. DSH's web shell is deskt
op-first: its entire stylesheet contains exactly **one** media query (`prefers-reduced-motion`) and
**no responsive breakpoints**, so at phone widths it renders the desktop three-column layout unreflo
responsive breakpoints**, so at phone widths it renders the desktop three-column layout unreflowed.
## What it does
Everything ships behind a toggle and defaults to on.
| Toggle | Effect |
| `mobileCss` | ≤640px only: reclaims the 56px rail, lets the open sidebar **overlay** the chat inst
ead of squashing it, makes tapping a session auto-collapse the sidebar, and stops the transcript ble

eding through the composer. |
| `usageDockCompact` | Keeps the usage indicator to one line. |
| `usa

geDockTerse` | Rewrites the dock to glyphs (`↓319M ·↑937K ·⚡100%`), dropping the noisy metrics. |
|
`enterNewline` | On mobile, **Enter breaks the line** and the send button sends — the mobile convent
ion. Stock DSH sends on Enter and only Shift+Enter breaks the line, which is two awkward taps on a p
ends on Enter and only Shift+Enter breaks the line, which is two awkward taps on a phone keyboard. |
Plus small correctness fixes: the composer gets an opaque background so the transcript can't paint t
hrough the band around it, and the dock is set to wrap rather than clip.

## Requirements

- DSH with a web profile
- A browser at ≤640px for the mobile work; the rest applies at any width
## Caveats, stated honestly
- **The composer still sits behind the iOS keyboard.** iOS Safari shrinks the *visual* viewport but
not the *layout* viewport, so the composer's toolbar row ends up under the keyboard. A fix that resi
zed the frame to `visualViewport.height` made this **worse** and was reverted — see `INTERNALS.md`.

Treat this as an upstream issue.
- **Class names are hashed** (`_3WPZCG_toggle`, `yhfFVG_card`). The
y are matched by substring, which is inherently fragile. `tools/health.mjs` checks 25 load-bearing a

ssumptions against a running instance and exits non-zero when DSH moves something.
- Developed and v
erified against one DSH version. It is CSS and DOM-shape dependent; expect to re-check after DSH upd
ed against one DSH version. It is CSS and DOM-shape dependent; expect to re-check after DSH updates.
## Development
`INTERNALS.md` is the engineering log: every measurement, dead end, and trap — including three self-
inflicted regressions and what caught them. If you are changing this plugin, read it first; it will
save you the same afternoons.
Two harnesses live in the sibling `tools/` directory of the origin workspace:

- `health.mjs` — do the selectors this plugin depends on still exist? (assumptions)
- `regress.mjs`
— **do the features still work?** (behaviour, in WebKit, since Chromium and iOS Safari do not measur
still work?** (behaviour, in WebKit, since Chromium and iOS Safari do not measure text identically)
Both exit non-zero on failure.
